reference.quote: alcohol use was divided into moderate (male: 1-40 g, female: 1-20 g), hazardous (male: 41-60 g, female: 21-40 g) and harmful (male: 61 + g, female: 41 + g)
reference.note: mids = category midpoints x7 g/week from the WHO g/day bands in the quote; open-ended top band assumed 75 g/day (M) and 50 g/day (F)

overlap.rationale_zh: 与核心饮酒领域测同一量；研究分层于年龄与地区并校正教育、收入、吸烟、体力活动、水果摄入，部分校正已计入项，系数 ≤0.6

evidence.quote: Among current drinkers, each 100 g/week higher alcohol intake was associated with higher mortality risks from cancers (HR 1·18 [95% CI 1·14-1·22]), cardiovascular disease (CVD; HR 1·19 [1·15-1·24]), liver diseases (HR 1·51 [1·27-1·78]), non-medical causes (HR 1·15 [1·08-1·23]), and all causes (HR 1·18 [1·15-1·20])
